pinboard.postRequest.doc: Post something to the noticeboard (an ask, an offer, a loan); the rest of the line is the post.

pinboard.listMyRequests.doc: List the posts you put up.

pinboard.respondToItem.doc: Answer a post (opens a chat with whoever posted it).

pinboard.markReturned.doc: Mark something you lent out as returned.

pinboard.reportPost.doc: Report a post to the circle's admins.
